proof_body:
by
  intro p n k hp hk
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hc : Nat.choose n k * k.factorial * (n - k).factorial = n.factorial := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hk
  have hv : padicValNat p (Nat.choose n k) + padicValNat p k.factorial + padicValNat p (n - k).factorial = padicValNat p n.factorial := by
    rw [← hc, padicValNat.mul (mul_ne_zero (Nat.choose_pos hk).ne' (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)) (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _), padicValNat.mul (Nat.choose_pos hk).ne' (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)]
  have f : ∀ m : ℕ, (p - 1) * padicValNat p m.factorial + (Nat.digits p m).sum = m := by
    intro m
    have h := sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial (p := p) m
    have h2 := Nat.digit_sum_le p m
    omega
  have hn := f n
  have hk' := f k
  have hl := f (n - k)
  rw [← hv, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add] at hn
  omega
target_source: ∀ (p n k : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → k ≤ n → (p - 1) * padicValNat p (Nat.choose n k) + (Nat.digits p n).sum = (Nat.digits p k).sum + (Nat.digits p (n - k)).sum
